method: Drain the defrosted prawns and leave to one side.
Put a large pot of water on to boil; when boiling, add salt and the pasta, and cook according to packet instructions, or slightly under.
Heat the garlic oil in a large pan and fry the spring onions and chilli flakes for a couple of minutes, then tip in the tomatoes with their oil, and the prawns.
When both have warmed through, add the white wine or Noilly Prat and let it bubble up. Add the rocket and stir until wilted a little.
Drain the pasta, reserving 125ml or so of its cooking liquid, and toss the drained pasta in the chilli-prawn pan.
Turn out into a large warmed serving bowl and toss everything again so that all is combined, adding a little of the cooking water if needed.
Sprinkle with the chopped parsley and serve.
